fields.sub_industry: Integrated delivery network and health plan
fields.business_model: Integrated provider-payer healthcare enterprise with clinical delivery, health-plan administration, shared services, and enterprise technology operations.
fields.customer_segments: Clinical operations; Health plan operations; Claims and benefits administration; Member service; Finance and actuarial; Enterprise data and analytics; Shared services
fields.mission: Deliver integrated care and health-plan services with reliable, governed data and measurable operating outcomes.
fields.vision: Create a trusted healthcare operating platform where clinical, claims, member-service, finance, and analytics teams can safely scale automation and AI.
fields.strategic_priorities: Build governed clinical and claims data foundation; certify patient/member identity spine; modernize Epic and analytics estate; baseline AI benefits before scale; improve member service and contact-center performance; strengthen PHI and model-risk controls
fields.leadership_team: CEO; CFO; CIO; CTO; CDAO; CISO; COO; Chief Medical Officer; Chief Experience Officer; VP Innovation; VP Shared Services
